construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

input.synthetic: Must be true; all example content is synthetic
input.actions: Up to 100 objects with exactly id, title, prerequisites, tags, minutes. Unique nonblank ids; title nonblank; prerequisites and tags lists of unique nonblank strings; minutes integer 1..1440
input.profile: Exactly completed (unique known action ids), goals (unique nonblank strings), available_minutes (integer 0..2880)
input.limit: Integer 1..10; limits recommendations, not journey candidate search
input.validation: Exact object fields; bool not accepted as integer; known acyclic prerequisites; completed history prerequisite-closed; duplicate JSON keys and nonstandard numeric constants rejected

output.success: schema_version, status=ok, synthetic=true, recommendations, journey, blocked
output.journey: status ready or unavailable; exactly two steps when ready, otherwise empty; total_minutes, validated, reason
output.step: Recommendation fields plus step, completed_before, prerequisites
output.blocked: Incomplete actions currently blocked by missing_prerequisites or exceeds_budget; excludes merely rank-truncated actions

cross_stage_handoffs: Shared input validation establishes a consistent catalog and completed-action set
Eligible current actions produce personalized next-action recommendations
Pair search passes completed plus first action into second-action eligibility
Selected pair is independently replayed by shared journey validation before serialization

behavior.recommendation_ranking: Descending count of matched goals, ascending minutes, ascending id
behavior.journey_ranking: Exhaustively consider feasible ordered pairs; descending distinct goal coverage, descending summed per-step matches, ascending total minutes, lexicographic ordered ids
behavior.budget: Recommendations individually fit; the two-step journey must cumulatively fit
behavior.completion: Prerequisites must be completed before a step; independent steps are allowed; no repeated or already completed actions
behavior.unavailable: Valid input with no feasible pair returns status ok and journey unavailable, never an invalid or partial journey
behavior.determinism: Catalog order does not affect results; no randomness, time dependence, network access, provider calls or input mutation
behavior.errors: File, encoding, JSON and semantic validation errors produce one JSON object on stdout and exit 2

test_outcomes.cli_result: One JSON object; status ok; validated seller-profile -> first-listing journey totaling 25 minutes
